title: Past-Due Standing and Default of a Patient Payment Plan
content:
Credit and Collections practice for **Patient Payment Plans** on plans that fall behind.

## Past due
A plan becomes past due when an installment is recorded missed, and a past-due notice goes out within the term's past-due notice period in business days. The plan becomes current (active) again only when every past-due installment is paid in full.

## Default
When the count of consecutive missed installments reaches the term's default limit, the plan defaults. Then:
- a default notice goes out within the term's default notice period in business days;
- the whole remaining plan balance is released back to its invoices;
- the invoices follow the term's handling at default: under *resume statement cycle* they resume the statement cycle at the next unused position; under *final notice immediately* the final notice is issued next.

## Counting consecutive missed installments
The count looks at the plan's installments from installment 1 up to the latest installment that has fallen due. It counts the most recent consecutive missed installments on the plan that are still unpaid, and stops at the first installment that was paid or deferred. A deferred installment is never counted as missed.

| Latest installments, oldest to newest (hypothetical) | Consecutive missed count |
|---|---|
| 3 paid, 4 missed and unpaid, 5 missed and unpaid | 2 |
| 3 missed and unpaid, 4 paid, 5 missed and unpaid | 1 — the count stops at installment 4 |
| 3 missed and unpaid, 4 deferred for hardship, 5 missed and unpaid | 1 — the count stops at the deferred installment 4 |
| 3 missed and unpaid, 4 missed and unpaid, 5 missed and unpaid | 3 |

## Applying the limit (hypothetical plans)
- On a term whose default limit is 2: the first row above reaches the limit and the plan defaults; the second and third rows do not.
- On a term whose default limit is 3: only the last row reaches the limit.

## Cure of a past-due plan
| Past-due installments paid | Plan standing |
|---|---|
| Every past-due installment paid in full | Current again |
| Some, but not every one, paid in full | Remains past due |
